title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. I expected better quality out of a brand connected with Henkle. I found these pans to be lacking. They just didn't seem to be as hefty as my old pans, and the construction was really lackluster. Most quality pans have their handles riveted to the pan for strength. These handles are just tack welded to the pan. I consider that to be a cheat and lacking in quality. We wound up returning them.
